headline: Investment-driven growth accelerates, AFFO guidance raised
summary_short: W. P. Carey posted Q2 2026 revenue of $461.1M (+7.0% y/y) and AFFO per diluted share of $1.34 (+4.7% y/y), with net income of $185.4M swinging sharply higher on a Lineage mark-to-market gain and accretive investment activity.
summary_long: Lease revenues rose 7.0% y/y to $461.1M on net investment activity ($706.5M in Q2, $1.3B YTD) and 2.6% same-store rent growth. Net income jumped to $185.4M from $51.2M, driven by a $41.6M mark-to-market gain on Lineage shares (versus a $69.0M prior-year loss), higher foreign-debt remeasurement gains, and accretive investments, partly offset by higher impairments and a lower gain on sale of real estate. AFFO per diluted share rose 4.7% to $1.34; occupancy held at 98.5%. WPC raised and narrowed 2026 AFFO guidance to $5.19-$5.27/share and lifted investment-volume guidance to $1.7B-$2.1B. Cash fell to $163.5M funding investments; post-quarter, WPC priced $350M of 5.200% notes due 2036 to refinance notes maturing October 2026.

drivers.explanation: Lease revenues and income from finance leases/loans receivable increased primarily due to net investment activity, alongside 2.6% contractual same-store rent growth.

A $41.6M mark-to-market gain on Lineage shares (vs a $69.0M prior-year loss), higher foreign-debt remeasurement gains, and accretive investment activity, partly offset by higher impairment charges and a lower gain on sale of real estate.
Net income growth outpaced a modest rise in weighted diluted shares (227.2M vs 220.9M y/y), driving per-share growth roughly in line with net income growth.
Growth reflects accretive net investment activity and contractual rent escalations across the portfolio.
Not explained in the release as a standalone item; consistent with $706.5M of Q2 investment volume funded from liquidity.
Not explained in the release; the $350M note issuance priced June 29 settled July 2, after the June 30 balance-sheet date, so it does not explain the y/y increase in reported long-term debt.
Retained net income and roughly $345M of net proceeds from settling forward equity agreements during the quarter, partly offset by dividends paid.
Profit growth was driven by accretive investment activity and a favorable swing in the Lineage equity mark-to-market, prompting raised full-year AFFO and investment-volume guidance.
